content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Operates route-based gaming terminals in bars and taverns, not promoting or hosting concerts and live events."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Owns a sports franchise and ballpark; it earns from team games, media rights and real estate, not promoting artist events."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Runs B2B trade shows for exhibitors and industry buyers, not consumer concerts, ticketing to fans or artist promotion."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Owns live entertainment venues hosting concerts, sells tickets, and provides event production to promoters, matching the target's model."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Online sportsbook, casino and betting shops are gambling businesses, not live event promotion or venue operation."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Sells cinema advertising and distributes events to theaters; it does not promote concerts or sell fan tickets."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Global advertising and marketing agency serving brands; it does not produce or promote live events or own venues."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Operates Las Vegas casino resorts earning gaming and hotel revenue, a different business from concert promotion and ticketing."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Marketing and advertising agency network selling campaign services to brands; no live event promotion or venues."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Publishes websites and magazines monetized by advertising and affiliate commerce, not live events or ticketing."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Operates family theme parks selling admission and passes to visitors; different experience and customers from concert promotion."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Owns radio stations and cable networks selling airtime to advertisers; broadcast media, not live event promotion."}]}
